name: Errant Knight
source:
A wuxia-inspired baihe visual novel about:

* THE KNIGHT—disgraced, pathetic, eager to be under someone's heel
* THE EMPRESS—cruel, sadistic, delighted about it
* THE SWORDMISTRESS—stoic, controlling, exasperated with everyone

[From [url=https://theoying.itch.io/errant-knight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部武侠风格的白鹤视觉小说，讲述：

* 骑士——耻辱、可悲、渴望被别人踩在脚下
* 女皇——残忍、虐待狂、对此感到高兴
*剑女——坚忍、控制欲强、对每个人都感到愤怒

[来自[url=https://theoying.itch.io/errant-knight]itch.io[/url]]
